fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Certification of no criminal record * 2. High school academic transcript Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 3. Bank Deposit certificate with no less than US$ 5,000 * 4. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. * 5. Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) * 6. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 7. Three Passport photos 8. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 9. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -Chinese and Mathematics scores are required. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Applicants must be a citizen of a country other than the People's Republic of China,and being good health. For the applicant who was originally a Chinese citizen and joined a foreign nationality, TUFE implements No.12 Notice of the Ministry of Education(2020). 2.The requirements for applicants' degree and age are that applicants must: (1) be a high school graduate over the age 18 and under the age of 30 when applying for the undergraduate programs. Applicants who have not reached the age of 18 before the date of registration for the new semester, he/she shall submit the original notarization certificate of the guardian issued by the Tianjin Notarization Office. The guardian must be a resident with permanent residence in Tianjin. 3.The applicant must conduct well and be physically and mentally healthy. To respect Chinese culture,and be willing to abide by the laws and regulations of China and the rules and regulations of Tianjin University of Finance and Economics is a must. 4.HSK 4 certificate.
